## Projects

::: {.home-note}
### [nanoFM](https://github.com/riteshrm/nanoFM)

A minimal PyTorch implementation of flow matching, connecting the mathematical formulation to training and sampling.

[Read the notes](posts/flow-matching/){.home-code}
:::

::: {.home-note}
### [nanoSBGM](https://github.com/riteshrm/nanoSBGM)

A minimal PyTorch implementation of score-based generative modeling, exploring SDE formulations and stochastic and deterministic sampling.

[Read the notes](posts/score-matching/){.home-code}
:::

::: {.home-note}
### [Qwen2.5 SFT](https://github.com/riteshrm/qwen2.5-tool-calling-lora)

Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-0.5B for tool calling with the xLAM dataset, with LoRA training and structured evaluation.

Achieved 93.89% tool accuracy and 98.75% valid JSON on 400 held-out test samples.

[Read the notes](posts/xlam-sft/){.home-code}
:::

::: {.home-note}
### [nanoOCR](https://github.com/riteshrm/nanoOCR)

A minimal OCR pipeline with DBNet text detection, CRNN text recognition, and ONNX inference with INT8 quantization.

The recognizer achieved 68.9% exact word-match accuracy on the IIIT5K test set.

[Read the notes](posts/ocr/){.home-code}
:::
